blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The General Information Sheets (GIS) of Gencorp Industries Inc. tied to Vice President Sara Duterte indicated that it had no rank-and-file employees in 2025, according to Senator-judge Joel Villanueva. In 2023 and 2024, the company only listed two rank-and-file employees, added Villanueva during the 42nd day of the impeachment trial of the vice president. “I was looking at GenCorp’s GIS, Your Honor. In its 2025 GIS, the company reported zero rank-and-file employees. Zero. In 2023 and 2024, however, it had two employees,” he said.
